repos_data.description: MCP Server for AI-powered video editing — Let Claude, GPT, or any AI agent edit videos through natural language
Guardrailed video editing MCP server for AI agents. FFmpeg, Hyperframes, repurposing tools, Python client, and CLI. Local, fast, free.
Video Editor for AI agents, built on the belief that open source can beat commercial tools
🔊 Text-to-Speech MCP plugin for Claude Code - hear audio feedback while coding (OpenAI TTS)

repo_meta_data.description: Your coding agent makes the demo video — a narrated, captioned MP4 from one storyboard.json. Deterministic replay re-renders it in CI (no key, ~$0). Open-source (MIT) alternative to Screen Studio / Clueso / Demosmith.
